name: Blur
text: Uses (4 charges). [action] If Blur has charges remaining: Evade. For this evasion attempt, you may use [willpower] instead of [agility] and get +2 skill value. If you succeed, spend 1 or 2 charges and you may take that many additional actions this turn. If you succeed by 0, take 2 damage.
text_cn: 使用(4充能)。 [action]如果身形虚化还有剩余充能：躲避。你这次躲避尝试+2技能值，并且你可以不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你成功，花费1或2充能并且这回合你可以进行等量次数的额外行动。如果你成功且等于难度，受到2点伤害。
